title: Frequent functions operable without looking away
requirement: The vehicle shall allow a seated driver to adjust cabin temperature, fan, audio volume and media track without looking away from the road, using controls that can be located and actuated by touch alone.
customer_value: Removes a measured attention cost on the functions used most while driving.
differentiation: Directly answers the most frequently evidenced criticism of the current generation.
validation_method: Seated-driver task test: eyes-off-road time per adjustment measured against a declared ceiling, plus blind-location success rate on first attempt.
assumptions: A tactile control layer can coexist with the current display architecture.
missing_evidence: No internal eyes-off-road measurement for the current car.

title: Driver-assignable shortcuts for personal frequent functions
requirement: The vehicle shall let a driver assign their own frequently used functions to shortcuts that are reachable in a single deliberate action and are identifiable without reading the screen.
customer_value: Restores a capability owners explicitly miss from the previous generation.
differentiation: Re-establishes parity with the outgoing car rather than beating rivals.
validation_method: Task test: assign and then invoke a personal function without screen reading; owner panel confirmation that the removed capability is restored.

title: Digital experience measurably improves during ownership
requirement: The vehicle shall receive over-the-air improvements to its infotainment and assistance experience throughout the ownership period, with each release stating in customer language what changed.
customer_value: Protects perceived value against rivals that visibly improve after delivery.
differentiation: Competitors already market this; absence becomes a visible gap by 2030.
validation_method: Release audit over a defined period: count of customer-visible improvements delivered over the air, and owner-perceived-currency survey.
missing_evidence: No evidence yet on which update cadence customers consider sufficient.

title: Up-front clarity on which digital features remain free
requirement: The vehicle and its purchase journey shall state, before order, which digital features are included for the life of the vehicle and which require later payment, with no function that was demonstrated as included becoming chargeable without notice.
customer_value: Removes a recurring trust irritant at the end of the included service period.
differentiation: Trust positioning rather than feature differentiation.
validation_method: Documentation audit against the delivered feature set, plus complaint-rate tracking at the end of included periods.

title: Sustained fast-charging power across the useful state-of-charge window
requirement: The vehicle shall sustain high DC charging power across the state-of-charge range customers actually use on long trips, such that a 10-80 percent stop completes within a declared time at a compliant high-power charger and the session average remains close to the advertised peak.
customer_value: Attacks the gap between headline peak and delivered stop time, which is the best-evidenced charging weakness.
differentiation: Peak power is already competitive; sustained power is where the car is beaten.
validation_method: Repeated 10-80 percent charge curves at a compliant charger, reporting session average and time, at declared ambient and preconditioning states.
assumptions: Thermal and cell-chemistry headroom exists to hold power for longer.
missing_evidence: No competitor charge curves measured under identical conditions.

title: Charging communicated as usable range per stop
requirement: The vehicle shall present charging progress and planning in usable range gained for the stop, under current conditions, rather than only as power or percentage.
customer_value: Matches the unit customers plan journeys in and makes a tapering curve honest.
differentiation: Low-cost credibility move that reframes a weakness as transparency.
validation_method: Compare predicted range-gained against measured range-gained across stops; accuracy band reported.

title: Reduced energy lost between charger and battery
requirement: The vehicle shall reduce the share of energy drawn from the charger that does not reach the usable battery, measured over a standard charging cycle, and shall make the measured figure available to the customer.
customer_value: Customers pay for charging losses twice, in money and in time.
differentiation: Independent testers already flag this, so improvement is externally verifiable.
validation_method: Metered input energy versus delivered battery energy over a standard cycle at declared temperature.

title: One account and one app across the charging journey
requirement: A driver shall be able to find, start, and pay for charging across the supported public network from the vehicle and its app without a second account or payment method.
customer_value: Keeps the strongest part of the current charging story intact.
differentiation: Already a positioning strength; the requirement is to protect it.
validation_method: Journey test across a sample of network operators, counting sessions completed without a secondary account.
missing_evidence: Network-breadth claims are manufacturer-sourced and unverified here.

title: Range promise that holds in real conditions
requirement: The range the vehicle presents to the customer shall reflect current load, speed, temperature and route, and shall be stated so that the achieved range on a representative German long-distance route falls within a declared band of the promise.
customer_value: Closes the brochure-versus-road gap that drives range disappointment.
differentiation: Credibility differentiator in a segment where everyone overstates.
validation_method: Independent-style route test comparing presented range against achieved range, winter and summer, reported as a band.

title: Comfortable ride in the standard configuration
requirement: The vehicle shall deliver ride comfort suitable for family and long-distance use in its standard suspension configuration, without requiring a chargeable adaptive suspension option, including on the wheel sizes most customers order.
customer_value: Makes the car's recognised comfort strength available without option hunting.
differentiation: Rivals increasingly make adaptive damping standard in this class.
validation_method: Ride-comfort assessment on standard suspension across the most-ordered wheel sizes, on a representative poor-surface route.
assumptions: Most-ordered wheel sizes can be determined from internal order data.
missing_evidence: No internal take-rate data for the adaptive suspension option here.

title: Daily touchpoints that feel premium and stay that way
requirement: Surfaces and controls the driver contacts daily shall retain a premium appearance and feel over the ownership period, without visible fingerprint retention or hollow-feeling actuation on frequently used controls.
customer_value: Addresses named details that independent review says tarnish quality perception.
differentiation: Perceived quality is a core premium promise; the criticism is specific and fixable.
validation_method: Tactile and appearance assessment of named touchpoints after a simulated ownership wear cycle, plus fingerprint-visibility test.

title: Autobahn quietness retained or improved
requirement: Interior noise at 130 km/h shall be no higher than the current generation's measured level, on the wheel and tyre combinations most customers order.
customer_value: Protects a measured strength that is easy to lose with larger wheels.
differentiation: Defensive: a regression here would be independently measured and published.
validation_method: Interior sound-level measurement at 130 km/h against the recorded 64.7-65.0 dB(A) baseline, same method.

title: Confident steering feel without optional hardware
requirement: The vehicle shall provide precise on-centre steering response and straight-line stability on rutted surfaces in its standard steering configuration, without requiring optional rear-axle steering, on the wheel sizes most customers order.
customer_value: Protects the brand's defining attribute where review and owner evidence agree it is currently option-dependent.
differentiation: Steering feel is the attribute customers most associate with the brand.
validation_method: On-centre response and tramlining assessment on standard steering across the most-ordered wheel sizes, with owner-panel confirmation.
missing_evidence: Owner tramlining reports are forum-sourced and not independently reproduced.

title: Electric estate variant with uncompromised load space
requirement: The successor range shall include a fully electric estate variant whose load space and passenger room are competitive with the combustion estate it replaces.
customer_value: Serves a German demand pocket that few competitors currently address.
differentiation: Electric estates are explicitly noted as still rare.
validation_method: Load-volume and passenger-room comparison against the outgoing combustion estate and available electric rivals.
missing_evidence: No sales or survey data here on electric estate demand size.
